scope.admission: Synchronous original GenerateOptions check after exact-model resolution and projection, immediately before adapter stream dispatch and each iterator.next
scope.default: No provider and not required preserves official Free behavior; required is monotonic and installed policy is unique and immutable
scope.boundary: Both regular and prepared calls; final dispatch after arbitrary llm/stream middleware awaits does not depend on listener order
limitations: No input or accepted-task proof is synthesized; consumer must bind an actual trusted root and current step
Provider resolution may complete before this dispatch gate; failed admission starts no adapter stream
Already started effects are not rolled back; cancellation and stream cleanup retain official behavior
scope.projection: Trusted immutable provider-envelope projection preserves route and tools. Async pre-dispatch validation precedes iterator construction; final admission is rechecked. Optional started notification runs once after first iterator.next is attempted, before consumption, even on zero-delta failure. Its failure aborts the call, queues iterator cleanup without blocking on an uncooperative adapter, and remains a host error; it is not a remote delivery receipt. Free without started notification retains its original signal.
